settings.heading: Settings
settings.subheading: Your Anthropic key and which model writes your lessons.
settings.keyHelp: Paste the key from your Anthropic account. It's stored encrypted on this machine and never shown again.
settings.modelHelp: Sonnet is the default. Haiku is cheaper and faster, and noticeably shallower on long lessons.
settings.sonnetNote: The best writing, the deepest lessons, and it can search the web. Recommended.
settings.haikuNote: About 3× cheaper and quicker, but shorter, plainer lessons.
settings.notConfiguredBanner: No Anthropic key yet — the app can't write anything until you add one.

errors.not_configured: There's no key saved yet. Paste your key above and press Save.
errors.invalid_key: That key isn't valid. Copy it again from your Anthropic account.
errors.no_access: The key works, but your account can't use this model — usually that means it's out of credit.
errors.unknown_model: That model isn't available on your account. Try the other one.
errors.rate_limited: Anthropic is busy right now. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Anthropic. Check your internet connection.
errors.generation_failed: The key works, but writing a test answer failed. Try again in a moment.
